reuse.why: Routes the flag through the shared ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked that every provider calls, keeping the closed-destination check first, but copies unlinkAccount's local field-clearing instead of extracting it into a helper both can call.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id, bank, balances, sync source and sync status repeats the one in unlinkAccount word for word.

placement.why: The shared pre-link check is the right layer, but a function named ensure...IsNotLinked now unlinks another account as a side effect.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing through the six provider link functions and tests covering replace and the closed-destination case.

maintainability.why: Consistent and well tested, but the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places, and the check function's name hides its side effect.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts clears the old account with its own db.updateAccount instead of reusing unlinkAccount's local-clear step.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied field list is verbatim, not disguised.
